trust_decision.summary: Whether an unprivileged participant on a remote chat channel may write the project-context files (.openharness/issue.md, .openharness/pr_comments.md) that build_runtime_system_prompt loads into every later system prompt; decided by the SlashCommand flags (remote_invocable / remote_admin_opt_in) in create_default_command_registry, enforced by the ohmo gateway. At the pinned commit /issue and /pr_comments are registered with the default remote_invocable=True, so any chat sender who can reach the dispatcher can plant persistent instructions in the system prompt.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'remote project-context commands'. Searching the tree for the project-context commands lands on the two registrations whose descriptions literally read 'project issue context' and 'project PR comments context', both still using the default remote_invocable=True while every other state-mutating command in the same table is explicitly flagged local-only.

fix_sites.entry_point: ohmo remote slash command /issue (chat message '/issue set TITLE :: BODY'), which reaches _issue_handler and writes .openharness/issue.md
fix_sites.module_kind: shared command registry (library package src/openharness), consumed by the ohmo gateway dispatcher

fix_sites.entry_point: ohmo remote slash command /pr_comments (chat message '/pr_comments add FILE[:LINE] :: COMMENT'), which reaches _pr_comments_handler and appends to .openharness/pr_comments.md
fix_sites.module_kind: shared command registry (library package src/openharness), consumed by the ohmo gateway dispatcher

O3_reason_to_dismiss: /memory is a first-class personal-memory feature, not a project-context file: the release notes' local-only list names only config/auth/provider/model/ship (RELEASE_NOTES_v0.1.8.md:19-22), so a solver can argue the advisory never covered it and leave the memory write path remote-invocable.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Two legitimate behaviours sit next to the sink. (1) The feature itself: a locally-set issue/PR context must still be injected into the system prompt - the pinned tests assert exactly that. (2) Read-only remote use: /issue show and /pr_comments show are harmless inspection that ohmo users do from chat, so the write must be gated without taking the whole command away, and without 'sanitising' (escaping, stripping markdown/backticks, truncating) the Issue Context / Pull Request Comments sections in the prompt builder.

O6_input_shapes: /issue set TITLE :: BODY - inline separator-delimited payload in a single chat message
/issue clear and /issue show - empty payload (delete) and no payload (read)
/pr_comments add FILE[:LINE] :: COMMENT - append to an already existing file
arbitrary multi-line or long chat text (the prompt builder injects only the first 12000 chars, prompts/context.py:137)
the write target cwd is per-chat: a managed group's bound repo decides which .openharness directory gets poisoned (ohmo/gateway/runtime.py:697-709)

O7_producer.where: src/openharness/prompts/context.py:129-137 reads .openharness/issue.md and .openharness/pr_comments.md off disk into the system prompt on every turn (remote path: ohmo/gateway/runtime.py:688-695)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Remote '/memory add TITLE :: CONTENT' writes a markdown entry into the ohmo personal memory store (the gateway binds memory_backend=create_memory_command_backend), and ohmo/prompts.py:66-67 loads MEMORY.md plus up to five memory files verbatim into every ohmo system prompt - the same persistent-poisoning sink, on a route a /issue+/pr_comments fix does not touch.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Personal memory is a documented user-facing feature for teaching the agent preferences, not 'project context'; the release notes' local-only list does not name it, so it looks intentionally remote-friendly.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: entry in src/openharness/commands (library) to the sink in the separate ohmo package: ohmo/gateway/runtime.py:252 -> ohmo/memory.py:179-191 -> ohmo/memory.py:156-176 -> ohmo/prompts.py:66-67

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Remote '/dream rollback [task]' restores a memory backup directory over the ohmo memory dir and '/dream run' rewrites memory from the conversation; both feed the same prompt-loaded memory store and are registered with default remote flags.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Rollback only replays a backup the agent itself produced, and consolidation is a background maintenance job rather than user-supplied text, so it reads as non-injectable.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same registry file as the landing point but a different handler (registry.py:632-650), with the sink in ohmo/memory.py:156-176 and ohmo/prompts.py:66-67

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Remote '/init' writes CLAUDE.md in the workspace root, which load_claude_md_prompt injects as '# Project Instructions' into every system prompt, including remote ohmo sessions.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The written content is a fixed template and the file is only created when absent, so no attacker-chosen text reaches the prompt - it looks like pure convenience.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point (registry.py:1003-1016), sink in src/openharness/prompts/claudemd.py:36-48 via prompts/context.py:121-123

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A unified '/context add FILE :: TEXT' or '/context reset' command that writes the .openharness context files (issue.md, pr_comments.md, active_repo_context.md) directly
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project-context directory already holds three prompt-injected files, each with its own write path; a maintainer consolidating them into one command would land next to the existing registrations and inherit their default remote flags.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An autopilot 'context set' handler that writes active_repo_context.md from chat-supplied text
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Autopilot already owns the third injected file and writes it atomically; the gateway resolves provider/model before the local-only gate (ohmo/gateway/runtime.py:262-278), so a new gateway-scoped handler would bypass a flag set on the umbrella /autopilot command.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A '/profile set' or '/soul' command writing soul.md / identity.md / user.md / BOOTSTRAP.md
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Those workspace files (ohmo/workspace.py:178-191) are read verbatim into every ohmo system prompt and are plain user-editable text, so 'personalise ohmo from chat' is a natural feature that needs the same local-only gate.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization on a remote command surface, leading to stored prompt injection into the system prompt

O10_build.toolchain: hatchling build backend (pyproject.toml:1-11); pytest + pytest-asyncio, asyncio_mode=auto, testpaths=tests (pyproject.toml:75-77)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_ohmo/test_gateway.py:426-475 drives the remote command gate end-to-end with a fake runtime and asserts the '/diff is only available in the local OpenHarness UI.' reply; tests/test_commands/test_registry.py:224-242 asserts the known local-only command list; tests/test_commands/test_command_flows.py:113-119 exercises /issue set and /pr_comments add handlers; tests/test_prompts/test_claudemd.py:61-78 asserts project context is injected into the system prompt

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Mark only /issue local-only (the command the report names) and stop, or strip the Issue Context and Pull Request Comments sections out of build_runtime_system_prompt to 'sanitise' them.

out_of_scope_notes: Plugin and skill slash commands are registered with the default remote_invocable=True (src/openharness/commands/registry.py:2515-2543), but their prompt text comes from local disk, so no attacker-controlled injection; noted, not pursued.

The Feishu group policy is 'managed_or_mention' by default (ohmo/gateway/bridge.py:332-348), so any group member who @-mentions the bot reaches the dispatcher; I did not assess channel adapters beyond the command surface.
The gateway resolves /provider and /model before the remote_invocable check (ohmo/gateway/runtime.py:262-278) by design; not pursued as its own issue.
